text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Running... is my way of praying.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Cough, cough...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I gasp for air, and that's when it hits me. That's when it's shoved in my face—the fact that I am breathing.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(A vertex of the Winter Hexagon, and one
of twenty-one
first-magnitude stars.
Twinkling with a gentle red light... is
Pollux.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(And there... just like any other night, I
know you're watching over
me.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Need to get going.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I pray. Not by clasping my hands, but by
kicking the dirt. Hoping that the splendor
waiting further along this path, the
warmth, all of
it...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...will find its way to you.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's almost tryouts, a crucial event where
trainers scout out promising
new talent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Visiting the racecourse, I find myself
among many of my colleagues
also here to
watch the fledgling runners practice for
their big day.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow! How about that turn of foot just
now!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She knows exactly when to make her move
too... Admire Vega is
quickly becoming my
top pick for tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a name I also had marked on my
list, I quickly turn my
attention to the
track.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, wheeze... Th-thank you for running with me!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Likewise. Are you done?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... I have plans to grab dinner with
Urara and a few others. Oh,
um... If you
want, you're welcome to—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass. I'm...
going to run a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah! R-right... Uh... Don't overdo it!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the others head off to meet with
friends, she alone continues to
train, not
looking the least bit bothered at missing
out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hahh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sheer amount of talent I sense from
her sends a chill down my
spine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega. She has a bright future
ahead of her, no doubt about it.
But I
wonder...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Back in my office, I begin poring over
every scrap of paper I can find on her. By
the time I resurface from my sea of
documents, it's dark
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I step outside, figuring I should get back
to the trainers' dorm, only to
find...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The place is deserted except for the lone
runner. She looks utterly
exhausted, but
despite that...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Come on! Keep going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't let up. Her pace refuses to
slack. It's almost as if...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally,
she seems to yield to the fatigue.
As her footsteps give way
to silence, she
turns her eyes toward the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Flooded with so many stars, her eyes seem
to waver, as if anxious that
they might be
swallowed up by that vast sea.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm caught off guard by my own question.
It just slipped out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. I always do this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pretty much.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No. It's what I need to do to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And I... will win. Run,
and win. That's all
there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you have trainer business to discuss,
wait
until after tryouts. Good
night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The lights shut off abruptly, leaving only
the starlight to illuminate
her as she walks
off, melting into the night.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A tremendous burden seems to weigh
upon her, so heavy it drives her to the
point of self-sacrifice. In the following
days, it weighs on my
mind as well.
